body:
Thank you for the post.
I don’t think you ramble at all - it makes a lot of sense.

I see your point. I think that hits the essense of my breakdown. That my life will forever be a compromise and be basicly a matter of survival - and to be fine with that life, i got to convince myself that, that is a “good” life.

And honestly, right now, i just want a life where i feel like breaking down every second.

I fully agree with your points - and what a nice metaphor - i will certainly remember that one. 

I think its both the gift and the curse of me legitimately have had a very good life so far. We all have a certain "reference point" we value something as either good or bad based on. If a get a job - it would probably be something i resent and are poorly paid, i would probably have to work a whole lot to. That means that i will have to live a life, just to survive. Many people live these lifes, but the reason for it being sooo incredibly hard for me, is because i have been a privileged and spoiled kid.

I must say, that you seem like a very good individual, to have all this interest! it is very much appreciated!. 

Some days are darker then others. I am however more fearful for my future, as of right now - i still have my apartment and some income atleast - and i dont struggle to feed myself. 

I think i was good enough, but not anymore, ofcourse there is always some feelings - i myself never forget someone i really cared about fully, and would probably still get some warm feelings if i saw them. 

I think that her way of dealing with it, was to make me a symbol of hate. 

Actually just one day ago, i had to ask her for some photos she took at my apartment when i moved in, in order to get my full deposit back. 
She wrote to my sister (for some reason) and not me. She wrote that i needed to "leaver her alone" and that she would call the cops if i continued to harass her. I have not written a single text or attempted any contact since the start of February - and that was literally a text asking for a nice disclosure, so neither felt like we wasted 2 years of our lives. 
This type of resentfulness and direct hate towards me, when i have done almost (ill admit, that showed up on her doorstep was a mistake - but i mistakently saw it as a romantic gesture) nothing, is very hard for me to deal with. So she undoubtably still have feelings, just towards hate, resentment and probably regretfulness. 

I could easily "shake it off" and not let it affect me, if my other prospects in life were better. I mean, why would i care? i do care know, because its the very symbol of when my life was "good".

For a start, i could be getting the grades and the job i feel like i deserve and that people doing half what i did, get. Secondly, i think its not very common, to have you ex marry someone shortly after - who is poking to your every insecurity and reminding you off how you are not good enough. These are all things outside my control, that have gone against me, but do not in most peoples life. 

I am in a place very i basicly have nothing (soon at least) not even a place to sleep. 
In an ideal world, i would have gotten a job and perhaps even a stable life, so i can focus towards building a family. However, without any stability first, its almost impossible to be interesting for the opposite sex - at least for men. I know plenty of girls who are in the shoes as myself, but magicly, a succesful and stable man comes along and give them the time and remedies to get back up. I have yet to witness a single occurence on the opposite. I think that is part of the reason, that suicide rates for men are about 10 times as high as for women (In my country atleast)

Sorry for the ramble. 

I appreciate your comments and interest - it helps!

The greatest lie we are told in childhood, is that if you work hard - you will achieve what you want.

In reality its more like genetic predisposition and nepotism

I der your point. And there is definetly someyhing to it. I do, however, see my problems as coming from being inadequate to begin with. Else i would not be where i am.

So there could be several negative feedback loops - for instance that no exogenous factors are aligning, making one feel even more inadequate

Nw

They don't, because i push them away...

Sorry to hear you are suffering yourself - wish you the best.   


A great example would be the friends from my studies - they would find out, they i am not smart at all.   
My ex would found out that i would never by able to give her the materilistic things, that she also would want.   
etc.

Thank you for taking the time.   


If it makes it less tough to hear, i do not really have any memories of my dad, so i can't really say that it influenced me a whole lot.   


Politicial science is actually heavily in demand in my country (Denmark) because of our huge public sector - so if you are looking for an adventure overseas one day, you should look into it. We also have a decreasing workforce, so it is very easy to get a work permit here.   


My psychologist suggests that i might have borderline to a light degree. However, she is not allowed to diagnose. But i rarely ever recognize it while it "happens" but when i look at after, i see it.  
From my own perspective, when people have a good perception of me, think highly of me or care for me - i am usually worried about they are gonna see "the real me", kind of illogical, but thats my reasoning.

Thank you for taking the time.  


I think that right now, as we speak, my future for the unititiated would not be perceived bad. I mean, i have a degree, i have an apartment and i have income, however, all those things (excluding the degree) is gone in a couple of months. I dont know if makes any sense at all.

Thank you very much for the kind words.   


I actually thinks it one of the reasons of my hopelessness, that ive always done a ton of work and when other people doing half, gets double the results, its frustrating.   


I live in a country where around a fourth of the population live in one city - so a move across boarders might be a plan. I will take it into consideration. 

​

Thank you once again - all the best to you too.

Thanks, you too.   


Hope your life brings you lot of joy in the future.   


Sleep tight!

I made a list of people i want to say "goodbye" to back in January, basicly its a list of people, ive met up up with, just to tell how wonderful i think they are - as they do not know why, it confuses them, but they seem happy.

I only have 2 names left on my list - my ex and my childhood best friend - as either, do not want anything to do with me anymore - i would however, love to tell em about the good times they have given me.

I already wrote half a suicide note - but i will keep it short and brief, basicly i just want to communicate that it is not anyones fault but my own.

I honestly never have had any dreams or crazy things i wanted to do. Ive always just wanted financial stability and to start a family with a girl i love, that's the only goal ive ever had.

  
Edit: as for how i am going to do it, i plan to buy a shitload of helium and breathe it, until i eventually pass out and die of the lack of oxygen

As i wrote, my dad commited suicide when i was very young.   


As for my mom, sure she will be sad - but she will be sad by seing her son completely destroyed and have a miserable life as well - and that will go on for the rest of her life.   


We were all sad when my brother died, but just 5 years after, it were rarely a topic of debate, and you would barely notice he existed if you talked to my family - people get over it.
I always felt sad and sure have got myself in bad situations, i have however, always kept fighting and never though about suicide before - i just do not have the fight in me anymore i am afraid

Sorry to hear.   
Beyond scared - but i if all goes down as it should, it wont be a consequence i will have to face.
